reasoning: Step 1: Classified under HS 94036000 (Other wooden furniture) based on product description.
Step 2: Tariff line 94036000 status is PREFERENTIAL under India-UAE CEPA.
Step 3: Identified MFN rate of 20% and CEPA preferential rate of 12.5%.
Step 4: Evaluated origin rule PSR-IN-R136 (CTH + VA 40%), which is met with 52.0% build-down value addition and valid tariff shift.
Step 5: Calculated estimated duty savings of 7500.00 AED based on 100000.00 AED shipment value.
Step 6: Mapped procedural requirements from Factory Registration through certificate issuance, fee, import claim, and record retention.
Step 7: Listed all required caveats regarding valuation basis, duty scope, free zone status, and issuing authority references.

origin_result.basis: Final manufacture takes place in the UAE and operations exceed minimal operations. All 2 non-originating inputs meet the CTH requirement outside heading 9403, and value addition reaches 52.0% against the 40% threshold on an FOB basis.

procedure.step: The Ministry of Economy and Tourism requires factory registration prior to applying for a certificate of origin, which requires the factory to be located outside a free zone and possess a MoIAT industrial licence with confirmation of 40% domestic value added.
procedure.authority: the Ministry of Economy and Tourism

procedure.step: The Ministry of Foreign Trade provides the Certificate of Origin for India e-service to submit the application along with required documents including commercial invoice and proof of factory registration.
The competent authority issues the certificate prior to, at, or within five working days of exportation, valid for twelve months for a single import.
The Ministry of Foreign Trade charges a certificate fee of AED 50 for a shipment value up to AED 100,000.
The Indian importer claims preferential tariff treatment when filing the bill of entry and must hold CAROTAR 2020 origin documentation, with electronic certificates reportedly uploaded to e-Sanchit.
The exporter must retain all origin records, including cost breakdowns, for at least five years starting from the end of the calendar year of issue.

caveats.note: '+' in a rule is read as 'and' (both tests must pass). The agreement does not define '+', so this is Mansha's interpretation.
Operations and final manufacture rely on the exporter's own declaration.
Factory declared in a free zone: likely not eligible for the ministry's factory registration; confirm with the ministry.
Estimate on the shipment value given. India charges duty on the assessable (CIF) value at import, so actual amounts will differ. Shown in the shipment's own currency; never converted.
CEPA rates reduce Basic Customs Duty (BCD) only. IGST, GST compensation cess, SWS and any anti-dumping or safeguard duty still apply.

No official page read names the Ministry of Foreign Trade as the issuer of the India CEPA certificate specifically: its service page covers preferential certificates in general, and the India-specific page is still on moet.gov.ae.
